# DirectDeals

> > DirectDeals is a software marketplace specializing in Microsoft products with instant digital downloads and flexible licensing options.

DirectDeals offers a comprehensive catalog of Microsoft software including Windows operating systems, Office suites, Windows Server editions, and business applications like QuickBooks. The platform provides both OEM and retail licensing options with immediate digital delivery for home and enterprise customers.

## Key Topics

- Product Catalog

## Windows Operating Systems

- [Microsoft Windows](https://directdeals.com/microsoft-windows): Microsoft Windows operating systems: Windows 11 and 10 editions
- [Windows 11](https://directdeals.com/windows-11): Windows 11 Home and Pro editions with OEM licensing options
- [Windows 10](https://directdeals.com/windows-10): Windows 10 Home and Pro editions with OEM and retail options
- [Legacy Operating Systems](https://directdeals.com/legacy-operating-systems): Legacy Windows editions including Windows 7 and 8.1 versions

## Microsoft Office Suites

- [Microsoft Office](https://directdeals.com/microsoft-office-8): Microsoft Office suite overview: 2024 and 2021 editions for Windows/Mac
- [Microsoft Office 2024](https://directdeals.com/microsoft-office-2024): Microsoft Office 2024 Home and Business editions with digital downloads
- [Microsoft Office 2021](https://directdeals.com/microsoft-office-2021): Microsoft Office 2021 variants: Home, Business, Student editions
- [Microsoft Office 2016](https://directdeals.com/microsoft-office-2016): Microsoft Office 2016 Home, Business, and Professional editions
- [Microsoft Office 2013](https://directdeals.com/microsoft-office-2013): Microsoft Office 2013 Professional edition for legacy users

## Windows Server & Enterprise

- [Microsoft Windows Server](https://directdeals.com/microsoft-windows-server): Windows Server editions 2019-2025 with enterprise licensing options
- [Windows Server 2025](https://directdeals.com/windows-server-2025): Windows Server 2025 Standard and Datacenter with CAL licensing
- [Windows Server 2022](https://directdeals.com/windows-server-2022): Windows Server 2022 Standard and Datacenter editions with licensing
- [Windows Server 2019](https://directdeals.com/windows-server-2019): Windows Server 2019 Standard, Essentials, and Datacenter editions
